endorsements.description: This talk will be about a Binder vulnerability that was first disclosed to Google by the Qihoo 360 C0RE Team, but also found by Jann Horn (who else?) and ourselves before it was fixed. The vulnerability was assigned CVE-2019-2025 and the Qihoo 360 guys named it "Waterdrop". Read more
